# Usama Javed

> Forward Deployed Engineer and Lead AI Engineer at Lakestone AI, Perth, Western Australia. Builds AI-native back-office software for businesses: extraction pipelines with judge models (JEV, CDM), agents that act within limits a person sets, assistants that answer from company data under row-level security, and the NetSuite and SimPro integrations underneath. Eight years of full-stack work across TypeScript, Node.js, React, .NET and Python. Every claim on this site is consistent with the resume and GitHub profile; projects are labelled production, personal or concept.

## In production (Lakestone AI, Perth, 2026)

- [AI back-office platform for a construction company](https://www.usamajaved.com.au/projects/ai-backoffice-construction): lead engineer. Invoice agent (Gemini extraction, confidence and drift gates, straight-through to SimPro receipt or escalation), supplier agent (ABN/ABR/BSB checks, certificate verification, fraud screening), inspection agent (three-run consensus extraction), 7,367-document corpus with Postgres FTS + pgvector behind per-tree permissions, chat assistant on a read-only Postgres role with exploit tests. Bun, Hono, React 19, Supabase RLS, Trigger.dev, Gemini, Langfuse, promptfoo.
- [Mail, property and agreement platform for a property agency](https://www.usamajaved.com.au/projects/property-agency-ems): Microsoft Graph mail sync, Gemini classification judged by JEV, drafts a person approves, command kernel with idempotency keys, outbox for external effects, Cirrus8 mirror, Entra sign-in. Live 14 October 2026.
- [Headless e-signature service and PDF toolkit](https://www.usamajaved.com.au/projects/lakestone-esign): sole author, six days. Email OTP signers, CAdES detached seals in TypeScript, HMAC webhooks, 40+ PDF tools (PDF/A, redaction, OCR), per-project feature modules, one CLI an agent can drive.

## Earlier production work

- [MCP NetSuite-Ollama bridge](https://www.usamajaved.com.au/projects/mcp-netsuite-ollama-bridge): MCP server letting marketing query NetSuite in plain English through a local Ollama model, in production at Ear Science Institute Australia. v2 adds LangGraph.
- Finance Sync App (Manage 9 to NetSuite) and Java/Python microservices on AWS Lambda/ECS with Terraform and GitLab CI, Ear Science Institute Australia, 2025-26.
- Payment gateway services for merchants including Badoo and Bumble at GlobalCharge (UK): merchant portal on AWS, standing-order service, OAuth/JWT/RBAC.
